* Abstract:
*
* This form is used to query order charges associated with products,
* attributes and antigens for a given patient.
*
* Inputs:
* The following tables are read:
* Orders, Pick_slips, Pick_slip_products, Pick_slip_product_antgns,
* Pick_slip_product_attr.
*
* Outputs:
* None.
*
* Error Conditions:
* 0200 -- invalid function key
* 0203 -- please press [CLRFRM] first
* 0317 -- invalid user_id */
* 1700 -- order does not exist
*
* Modules Referenced:
* Check_Package_Failure, Handle_Error, Nullchk, Show_Error,
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This form will take patient name as input from the user and query the
* database tables accordingly.
*
***************************************************************************
**

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011 -- updated to new tz function -- 12/22/2017 -- V02
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 -- 
 :s_patient_name := :patients.patient_name;

 if :patient_aborh is not null then -- 12/22/2017 -- V02
 begin
 select abo_desc
 into :s_aborh_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :patient_aborh
 AND rownum < 2
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('0300'); -- Invalid blood type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
temp_other_charges number(9,2);
db_other_charges number(9,2);
cr_other_charges number(9,2);
total_other_charges number(9,2);
chp_sysdate date;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 begin
 select lpad(to_char(nvl(sum(decode(psp.product_type,
 'RPL',(psp.product_price * vs.std_price) / 1000,
 'RPFF',(psp.product_price * vs.std_price) / 1000,
 psp.product_price)),0)),9,' ') into :s_product_charges
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps,
 vserv_products vs
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and vs.product_code = substr(psp.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(length(psp.product_code),8,'I',5,'C')
 AND chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate + 365) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 :s_product_charges := 0; --HCL null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 /*
 select lpad(to_char(nvl(sum(price),0)),9,' ') into
 :s_antigen_charges
 from pick_slip_product_antgns psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id;
 */
 select std_price into :s_antigen_charges
 from antigen_pricing_matrix
 where chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1) and
 antigen_qty in (select count(*)
 from pick_slip_product_antgns psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 :s_antigen_charges := 0; -- HCL null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select lpad(to_char(nvl(sum(price),0)),9,' ') into
 :s_attribute_charges
 from pick_slip_product_attr psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 :s_attribute_charges := 0; --HCL null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select (nvl(sum(amount),0)) into
 temp_other_charges
 from order_charges
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select nvl(sum(amount),0) into
 db_other_charges
 from customer_dbcr_adjust
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no
 and tran_type = 'DB';
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 db_other_charges := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select nvl(sum(amount),0) into
 cr_other_charges
 from customer_dbcr_adjust
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no
 and tran_type = 'CR';
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 cr_other_charges := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 total_other_charges := (db_other_charges + temp_other_charges
 - cr_other_charges);
 :s_other_charges :=lpad(to_char(nvl(total_other_charges,0)),9,' ');
 :s_grand_total := :s_other_charges + :s_product_charges +
 :s_attribute_charges + :s_antigen_charges;
end;
